vxht90a9.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
vxht90a9.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
vxht90a9.sourceDescription: The fully-decorated Christmas tree with stylish illuminated branches and colourful baubles creates a nice atmosphere in the coming Christmas. The artificial tree is made of PVC, which is lightweight and weather-resistant. The Christmas tree has an IP rating of IP44 and is, therefore, suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use. The branches can be arranged in any shape you like. They also contain 150 LEDs, which are very energy-efficient and emit a bright warm light. Designed with 4 different lighting effects, continuous lighting, twinkling, crossfade and slowly glowing mode, the lights beautifully illuminate in your preferred pattern. It is a real eye-catcher, especially in the evening. It can also serve as an ambient light source. This Christmas tree can be used every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: White Bauble colour: Gold and silver Material: PVC, plastic Tree height: 150 cm Maximum tree diameter: 80 cm Voltage: 5 V⎓ Power: 3 W USB interface With 150 LEDs With 380 branches With 4 lighting effects Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree with 150 LEDs 1 x 20 cm silver tree topper 20 x 4 cm bauble (10 x gold and 10 x silver) 20 x 6 cm bauble (10 x gold and 10 x silver) 12 x Pine cone This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
